# Hosts this app is allowed to contact from src/ code.
# One host per line. Add a line above the new host when a PR
# legitimately introduces a new fetch/axios call, with a comment
# explaining what it's for and pointing at the file.

# src/utils/translate.ts - optional report translation (MyMemory, keyless)
api.mymemory.translated.net
mymemory.translated.net

# src/utils/share.ts - "Share via Telegram" fallback opens t.me with the
# report text URL-encoded into the query string (Linking.openURL, not a
# fetch call - hands off to the OS/Telegram app rather than sending data
# from this app directly, but the report text does leave the device in
# the URL, so it's tracked here deliberately).
t.me
